sloka: महोदरं प्रहस्तं च विरूपाक्षं च राक्षसम् ।मत्तोन्मत्तौ च दुर्धर्षौ देवान्तकनरान्तकौ ॥
transliteration: mahodaraṁ prahastaṁ ca virūpākṣaṁ ca rākṣasam ।mattonmattau ca durdharṣau devāntakanarāntakau ॥

translations.english: The speaker questions why they are praising Indrajit, having overlooked other greatly valorous warriors.
